name: FINOS TraderX — PostgreSQL Database Replacement
description: State 005 replaces H2 database runtime with PostgreSQL while preserving state 004 containerized ingress topology and baseline flows.

nodes.name: NGINX Ingress
nodes.description: Single browser entrypoint for UI + API + websocket.

flows.name: F3/F4: Ingress-Routed Trade Submission & Persistence
flows.description: Routes browser trade tickets through the edge/ingress proxy, validates ticker and account, streams over messaging broker, and updates persistent holdings.

transitions.description: User submits trade ticket through single browser-facing proxy.
Proxy forwards trade request to Trade Service.
Trade Service publishes trade event to messaging broker.
Trade Processor consumes trade event from messaging broker.
Trade Processor persists trade and upserts position.
